title: Structured Prediction for Scalable Spreadsheet Table Understanding: From Cell Types to Table Ranges (Extended Version)
abstract: arXiv:2608.16050v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spreadsheets are a primary medium for publishing tabular data, yet automatically extracting structured content from them remains difficult due to heterogeneous layouts, diverse file formats, and inconsistent organizational conventions. We address two core tasks in spreadsheet understanding: Cell-Type Classification (CTC), which assigns roles to cells, and Table Detection (TD), which identifies table bounding boxes within sheets. We propose an efficient two-stage pipeline in which a learned CTC model feeds a deterministic TD algorithm. For CTC, we use a LightGBM classifier over 65 structured features together with a pairwise CRF enforcing spatial consistency across the cell grid. Our TD method extracts table ranges from predicted cell types by a deterministic five-stage procedure. translated_title: 面向可扩展电子表格表结构理解的结构化预测：从单元格类型到表格范围（扩展版）
translated_abstract: 电子表格是发布表格数据的主要媒介，但由于布局异构、文件格式多样以及组织惯例不一致，从其中自动提取结构化内容仍然困难。我们解决了电子表格理解中的两个核心任务：单元格类型分类（CTC），即为单元格分配角色；以及表格检测（TD），即识别工作表中的表格边界框。我们提出了一种高效的两阶段流水线，其中学习的CTC模型为确定性TD算法提供输入。对于CTC，我们使用基于65个结构化特征的LightGBM分类器，并结合成对条件随机场（CRF）在单元格网格上强制执行空间一致性。我们的TD方法通过一个确定性的五阶段过程，从预测的单元格类型中提取表格范围。为了评估，我们构建并共享了StatSheets，这是一个多语言基准数据集，包含来自多个国家14个公共数据提供商的737个手动标注电子表格。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合LightGBM分类器和成对CRF的两阶段流水线，用于电子表格中的单元格类型分类和表格检测，并构建了多语言基准数据集StatSheets以支持可扩展的表结构理解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage pipeline combining LightGBM classifier and pairwise CRF for cell-type classification and table detection in spreadsheets, and constructs a multilingual benchmark StatSheets to support scalable table structure understanding.
